ValidationRule.description: VR for Finland to check if the OVT fields are filled in case of E-invoicing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && NOT( ER_SmartER_Context__c ) && ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c ,'FI') && NOT( ISPICKVAL($User.UserType , 'AutomatedProcess')) && ISPICKVAL(ER_Preferred_Invoicing_Method__c , 'E-invoice') && ER_SmartER_Original_Lead_Id__c == null && (ERFI_OVT_Operator__c == null || ERFI_OVT_Code__c == null)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Both the fields OVT Code and OVT Operator have to be filled when the preferred method is e-invoicing.
